NIA conducts nationwide raids in online terror radicalisation cases

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has conducted searches across multiple states in connection with online terror radicalisation cases. Reports indicate raids took place in at least 10 states, with some outlets specifying 20 locations. The agency reportedly seized digital devices and is investigating alleged links to banned terrorist groups, including ISIS and AQIS, and a specific case involving an attack on an RSS office in Ranchi.
